name: Rivian Varrison
source:
Height: 5'9"

The son of a famous military strategist, Rivian is sarcastic, skeptical, and often too curious for his own good. He's very clever and equally as picky, but he has a good heart. Supposedly.

Hates: Parties
Loves: Sweets
